profile.headline: Senior Staff Android Engineer At HEB

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led Android Team in creating a new Shopping app using kotlin multiplatform, Jetpack Compose, Server Driven UI, and Graph QL.

Part of the DEI (Diversity, Equity, Inclusion) Council for the Saks company.
positions.insights: Skills: Kotlin · GraphQL · Android Jetpack · Kotlin Coroutines · Kotlin Multiplatform · Android Development · Server Driven UI

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Co-chair of our Latino Alliance Teammate Resource Group

Taking action to help define strategies for Testing, Architecture, and code quality across the software organization.
 
Lead Android Devices team to architect and implement various new features which accompanied our company’s connected devices library into the MapmyRun and UA Record Apps. 

Architected and integrated 3 Generations of Under Armour’s Connected Shoe

Architected and integrated JBL Heart rate enabled headphones

Architected and integrated Under Armour’s HealthBox offering which included connected scale, Heart Rate monitor, and connected band.

positions.title: Customer Engineer
positions.description:
Provided support between developers and customers using our PowerVR graphics chips.

Provided first level analysis of issues on Android and Linux Systems.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: In IBM I worked as a Software engineers with A year experience in Network device driver development, and 3 years experience with AIX kernel bringup which included developing and maintaining the Enhanced Error Handling functionality and Direct Memory Access for PCI and virtual buses. I also had  year of experience with diagnostics and worked with packaging the Diagnostics CD and the microcode facility.

positions.title: EOE Office Student Assistant and Tutor
positions.description:
Facilitated many office tasks and departmental events.

Assisted with web development of office website.

Tutored students in an Introduction to Programming course.

positions.title: Product Development Intern - Software and Controls
positions.description:
Created an in-house Database Conversion program

Created wire harnesses for test benches.

positions.title: Intern - Computer Service Division
positions.description:
Repaired many damaged and malfunctioning systems

Worked on a small team of six to cover entire capital complex.

Completed over 100 work orders
